Package Models

Class BenevolentPlayer

java.lang.Object
Models.PlayerBehaviorStrategy
Models.BenevolentPlayer
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class BenevolentPlayer extends PlayerBehaviorStrategy
BenevolentPlayer class represents a player behavior strategy that focuses on helping weaker countries and avoiding aggressive moves.
